start.title: Two Years Later
start.text:
Dawn breaks on your prison cell.
Footsteps approach the iron door.

choices.text: Rise and pray to the Lord

curse_consequence.title: Hollow Anger
curse_consequence.text:
Anger only weighs you down.
The key still turns in the lock.

choices.text: Rise and pray to the Lord

hide_consequence.title: No Hiding
hide_consequence.text:
The guard pulls back the blanket.
"Pharaoh has called for you."

choices.text: Rise and pray to the Lord
choices.feedback: You stand up trembling but firm.

summons.title: Pharaoh Calls
summons.text:
"Pharaoh demands you. Quickly!"
The magicians have all failed him.

choices.text: Shave and dress for the king

boast_consequence.title: Empty Words
boast_consequence.text:
The guard frowns. "Many boasted.
None could read the dream."

choices.text: Shave and dress for the king

refuse_consequence.title: Dragged Forth
refuse_consequence.text:
The guard grips your arm hard.
"Pharaoh will not be denied."

choices.text: Shave and dress for the king

preparation.title: Made Ready
preparation.text:
Razor and clean linen await.
You must look fit for a king.

rehearse_consequence.title: Empty Words
rehearse_consequence.text:
Your guesses crumble in your mind.
Only God knows the dream.

antechamber_arrive.title: Palace Halls
antechamber_arrive.text:
Cool stone, painted columns.
An official waits to lead you in.

demand_consequence.title: A Hard Look
demand_consequence.text:
The official stiffens. "You stand
before the king. Walk."

throne_enter.title: The Throne Hall
throne_enter.text:
Light pours through high windows.
Pharaoh sits, deeply troubled.

stare_consequence.title: Eyes Down
stare_consequence.text:
Guards step forward. The official
hisses, "Bow before the king!"

pharaoh_speaks.title: The King's Words
pharaoh_speaks.text:
"I have dreamed. None can interpret.
I hear you can. Is it so?"

choices.feedback: You take credit that isn't yours.

choices.text: "It is not in me; God will speak"
"I will try my best, mighty king"

claim_consequence.title: Pride Cracks
claim_consequence.text:
Pharaoh's eyes narrow. The room
grows quiet. You feel God's nudge.

try_consequence.title: A Shaken Heart
try_consequence.text:
Words feel hollow in your mouth.
This is not your wisdom to give.

choices.text: "It is not in me; God will speak"
choices.feedback: You speak the truth at last.

humble_answer.title: God Will Answer
humble_answer.text:
Pharaoh leans forward, quieter now.
"Then hear my dream, Hebrew."

interrupt_consequence.title: Be Silent
interrupt_consequence.text:
Pharaoh raises his hand. "Listen,
then speak. Not before."

choices.feedback: You bow your head and wait.

cattle_dream.title: Seven Cattle
cattle_dream.text:
"Seven fat cows came from the Nile.
Seven gaunt cows ate them whole."

choices.text: Tell him what cows mean in Egypt

egypt_lore_consequence.title: Not Yet
egypt_lore_consequence.text:
Pharaoh frowns. "There is more.
Hear the second before you speak."

grain_dream.title: Seven Heads
grain_dream.text:
"Seven full heads of grain rose.
Seven thin ones swallowed them up."

choices.feedback: God puts words in your mouth.

idols_consequence.title: Holy Silence
idols_consequence.text:
Your tongue stops mid-praise.
God alone gives the answer here.

sign_consequence.title: No Delay
sign_consequence.text:
Pharaoh waits. The room is still.
God's word is already in you.

choices.feedback: You open your mouth in faith.

interpretation.title: One Dream
interpretation.text:
"The dreams are one, O King.
God has shown what He will do."

soften_consequence.title: Speak True
soften_consequence.text:
Half-truth helps no one.
A king must hear the full word.

plain_truth.title: Seven and Seven
plain_truth.text:
"Seven years of plenty will come.
Then seven years of famine."

stop_consequence.title: Finish It
stop_consequence.text:
Pharaoh waits. "What then?
What must I do, Hebrew?"

give_counsel.title: A Wise Plan
give_counsel.text:
"Find a wise man. Store one fifth
of the grain in years of plenty."

self_consequence.title: Quiet, Joseph
self_consequence.text:
Pharaoh tilts his head. Pride
would undo all you have said.

silver_consequence.title: No Price
silver_consequence.text:
God's word is not for sale.
You feel shame for asking.

leave_choice.title: The King Decides
leave_choice.text:
Pharaoh stands. The court is silent.
"Can we find such a man?"

push_consequence.title: Hold Your Tongue
push_consequence.text:
The court murmurs. Pharaoh frowns.
You hold your peace at last.

pharaoh_chooses.title: God's Spirit
pharaoh_chooses.text:
"Can we find one with God's Spirit
like this man? You shall rule."

refuse2_consequence.title: God's Hand
refuse2_consequence.text:
Refusing the call is refusing God.
This door He has opened.

choices.feedback: You bow and rise as servant.

ring_given.title: The Signet Ring
ring_given.text:
Pharaoh slides his ring on you.
"None shall lift hand without you."

choices.text: Forget the God who lifted you
Give thanks to God in your heart

forget_consequence.title: Remember Him
forget_consequence.text:
The ring is heavy on your finger.
This honor is not your own.

choices.text: Give thanks to God in your heart

ride_out.title: Second Chariot
ride_out.text:
You ride through Egypt's roads.
Men bow as you pass.

revenge_consequence.title: Not Yet
revenge_consequence.text:
That story is not yet told.
God has bigger plans here.

boast2_consequence.title: Stay Humble
boast2_consequence.text:
Pride could undo all of this.
You remember the prison floor.

choices.feedback: You ride on in quiet faith.

ending.title: From Pit to Palace
ending.text:
God remembered you in the dark.
Now nations will be saved.
